```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function hideCategories() {
    document.querySelectorAll(
      "#quarto-margin-sidebar .quarto-category, " +
      "#quarto-margin-sidebar .category, " +
      "#quarto-margin-sidebar .quarto-listing-category, " +
      "#quarto-margin-sidebar a"
    ).forEach(function (el) {
      const name = el.textContent
        .trim()
        .replace(/\s*\(\d+\)\s*$/, "")
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();

      if (name === "award" || name === "people" || name === "featured") {
        el.style.setProperty("display", "none", "important");
      }
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", hideCategories);
  window.addEventListener("load", hideCategories);

  // Reapply if Quarto updates the sidebar dynamically.
  const observer = new MutationObserver(hideCategories);
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });
})();
</script>
```
